activation: No retention action or live deletion is authorized by this metadata. Deletion remains disabled until implemented recovery, export, tombstone and restore qualification pass.

policies.physicalReclamation: Only explicit account erasure or verified canonical compaction retaining equivalent authoritative commitments. Never delete to recover a quota slot.
policies.recovery: Keep lossless export and data-preserving schema rollback before migration.

policies.physicalReclamation: Future opt-in private event store only; after event age reaches 90 days AND at least 30 days have passed since export-expiry notice, corrected summary publication and active-reader closure. Existing retained data is grandfathered.
policies.recovery: Disclose that expired detail cannot be reconstructed from aggregates; retain independent correction/deletion controls.

policies.physicalReclamation: After manifest-pinned successor is verified, active readers settle and pending/recovery references no longer depend on this version.
policies.recovery: Rebuild exactly from committed canonical evidence; never infer commitment from R2 existence.

policies.physicalReclamation: Retain minimal non-content generation/tombstone evidence while any accepted credential, delayed operation or restorable backup could replay. No time-only GC until finite replay and backup cutoffs are enforceable.
policies.recovery: Restore reconciles current controls before making restored facts readable.

policies.physicalReclamation: Only after an authoritative terminal disposition, no pending/reader/recovery reference, and at least 30 days. Unknown disposition is retained and charged.
policies.recovery: Recompute reachability from committed publication history; timeout is not abandonment.

policies.physicalReclamation: Future managed backup/rollback artifacts expire only after successor restore test, deletion-control reconciliation and explicit horizon enforcement. No existing backup is shortened.
policies.recovery: Old backup restore beyond accepted cutoff must refuse or reapply retained controls before reads.

objectives.rpo: Zero acknowledged canonical publications lost within the qualified local/replicated storage fault model; simultaneous loss outside that model is explicitly unsupported until independently durable backups qualify.
objectives.rto: Target one hour for tested supported recovery; currently unqualified. No activation claim until measured rehearsal.
objectives.publicWithdrawal: At most the current public cache bound after authority revalidation; never equate cached visibility with current consent.
